disorder-name.detail: First-episode psychosis; schizophrenia spectrum diagnoses including schizophrenia (n=57, 72%), schizophreniform disorder (n=18, 23%), and schizoaffective disorder (n=4, 5%). The paper labels the combined clinical cohort as 'SCZ' in analyses.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "patients with a first-episode schizophrenia spectrum diagnosis (SCZ) were consecutively recruited"; "schizophrenia (n = 57, 72% of the final, quality-checked longitudinal sample), schizophreniform disorders (n = 18, 23%), and schizoaffective (n = 4, 5%)"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Thematically Organized Psychosis (TOP) study at the University of Oslo and Oslo University Hospital

age.detail: Age at baseline for the combined FEP group (N=79). Mean and SD from Table 1; range (18-53 years) from supplementary materials.
age.location: Berthet2025.pdf.md: Results / Table 1, L87-L91; media-1.pdf.md: Participants, L45

sex.detail: Paper reports 41.7% female at baseline (N=79). Female N estimated as round(79 × 0.417) = 33; male N = 79 - 33 = 46. Percentages recalculated from estimated counts: 33/79 = 41.8%, 46/79 = 58.2%.
